$description: Hendri design tokens, generated by Brand Forge. Light and dark are separate top-level groups under `color`: the DTCG theming module is still draft, so modes are a convention here rather than a spec feature.

primitive.$description: Generated ramps. Tune colour here; do not reference these from code.

semantic.$description: The consumable layer. Everything here aliases a primitive.

background.$description: The page. Every screen starts here.

surface.$description: Cards, panels and anything sitting one level above the page.

surface-raised.$description: Popovers, dropdowns, dialogs — one level above `surface`. In light mode this equals `surface`: elevation there is `--shadow-lg`, not a lighter fill.

muted.$description: Quiet neutral fill — table headers, inactive tabs, code blocks.

foreground.$description: Primary text and icons. The default ink for body copy and headings.

foreground-secondary.$description: Supporting copy set at `body-lg` or larger — subtitles, section intros, lead paragraphs. It is the only supporting text colour verified against `surface-raised`, so use it inside dialogs and popovers. For anything at `body-sm` or below on a flat surface use `muted-foreground`, which carries more contrast because small text needs it.

muted-foreground.$description: Small supporting text — captions, helper text, metadata — on `background`, `surface` or `muted`. Verified against those three only; on `surface-raised` use `foreground-secondary`.

foreground-tertiary.$description: Deliberately faint text: placeholders, disabled labels, watermarks. NEVER body copy — it does not meet contrast for reading.

state-hover.$description: Hover wash on a neutral interactive surface — menu items, table rows, ghost buttons. It lightens in dark mode against `background` and `surface`, but `surface-raised` is lighter still, so on a popover the same wash reads as a darkening. That is the wash working, not a bug — it moves away from the surface either way.

state-active.$description: Pressed state of a neutral interactive surface.

state-selected.$description: Selected/current state — brand-tinted so selection reads as intent, not hover.

state-disabled.$description: Fill of a disabled control. Pair with `foreground-tertiary`.

border.$description: Default hairline between regions — card edges, dividers, table rules.

border-subtle.$description: Barely-there separator inside an already-bounded area. Deliberately below the visible-boundary threshold — never use it as the only thing dividing two regions.

border-strong.$description: Emphasised border — hovered fields, pulled-out quotes.

input.$description: Border of a form control at rest.

ring.$description: Focus ring. Always visible on keyboard focus — never remove it.

primary.$description: Solid primary fill — primary buttons, active nav, key accents.

primary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a solid `primary` fill. Never use it on a page background.

primary-hover.$description: Hover state of a solid `primary` fill.

primary-active.$description: Pressed/active state of a solid `primary` fill.

primary-subtle.$description: Tinted primary wash — quiet badges, selected rows, callouts. Not a text colour.

secondary.$description: Solid secondary fill — secondary buttons and supporting accents.

secondary-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a solid `secondary` fill. Never use it on a page background.

secondary-hover.$description: Hover state of a solid `secondary` fill.

secondary-active.$description: Pressed/active state of a solid `secondary` fill.

secondary-subtle.$description: Tinted secondary wash — quiet badges, selected rows, callouts. Not a text colour.

success.$description: Solid success fill — success buttons, filled badges, chart series.

success-foreground.$description: Text and icons on a solid `success` fill.

success-hover.$description: Hover state of a solid `success` fill — a success button.

success-active.$description: Pressed state of a solid `success` fill.

success-subtle.$description: Background of a success banner, alert or inline message.

success-subtle-foreground.$description: Text on `success-subtle`. This is the success text colour — not `success`.

success-border.$description: Border of a success banner or field.

warning-border.$description: Border of a warning banner or field.

breakpoint.$description: Mobile-first min-widths. A closed set — no max-width breakpoints exist.

sm.$description: Large phones in portrait. Rarely a layout change on its own.

md.$description: Tablet. Side-by-side content becomes possible; nav can unfold.

lg.$description: Laptop. Multi-column layouts and persistent sidebars.

xl.$description: Desktop. Wider gutters, more columns — rarely bigger type.

container.$description: Max-widths. Nothing spans the viewport; every region sits in one of these.

prose.$description: Running text. ~70 characters at body size — the readable measure.

narrow.$description: Forms, dialogs, sign-in — anything with one column of controls.

page.$description: The default page frame. Most layouts live here.

wide.$description: Dashboards and tables that genuinely need the room.
